def panel(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,(c0,c1) in [('red',(27,30)),('green',(33,36)),('blue',(39,42))]:
        out[name]=[a[58][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
    return out
def blocks(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','N','b') and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(rs)<40: out[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs))
    return out
